name: Human Gate
description: Human-in-the-loop approval middleware. Routes selected tool calls through OpenClaw's built-in approval flow (TUI / Control UI / chat /approve) before execution. Also adds a Claude Code-style ask tool for clarification.

matches.description: Regex matched against a string parameter value. Only string parameters match; invalid regexes never match.

defaultMode.description: Fallback decision for a tool that no rule and no classifier matches. Defaults to fail-closed approval.

rememberAllowAlways.description: Persist allow-always decisions per session only when analysis can construct a narrow path-bound grant fingerprint.

allowAlwaysTtlMs.description: Upper bound (ms) for a persisted allow-always grant. The native button still reads 'allow-always'; internally the grant is a bounded session/task lease that expires after this duration.

useClassifiers.description: Run the built-in read-only/destructive classifier after user rules. Reads pass through; writes/exec get gated without listing every tool.

semanticAnalysis.description: Upgrade-only parameter analysis for shell, Code Mode, and file mutations. It can increase severity or require approval, never lower a base decision.

previews.description: Bounded, sanitized approval previews for commands and file mutations.

unattendedPolicy.description: Controls calls that cannot be interactively approved in cron/heartbeat contexts.

critical.description: block is the safe default; auto preserves the legacy unattended behavior for critical calls.

approvalWindow.description: After approval, matching semantic fingerprints may auto-pass for a turn or time box. Unknown, empty, or incomplete analysis never opens a reusable window.

mode.description: off = prompt every gated call; turn = reuse only within the current agent run; time = reuse for ttlMs.

ttlMs.description: Window duration for mode 'time'. Ignored otherwise.

match.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for scope. An explicit scope wins when both are present. Use scope for new configurations.

scope.description: Reusable authorization boundary. Runtime default: path. destructive and same-tool are legacy compatibility scopes; effect and category include semantic sets; path also includes a bounded exact set of analyzer-verified target directories.

pathFallback.description: Explicit behavior when path scope has no analyzer-verified target resolvable as an absolute path or against a host-authoritative execution cwd. none opens no reusable authorization.

bypassCritical.description: severity 'critical' calls always prompt even when a window is open (e.g. production deploys).

adaptiveAutoPass.description: Bounded adaptive handling for complete, non-destructive local file writes with analyzer-verified absolute targets. allow-once decisions are shadow/suggestion evidence only and never expand authorization; only an explicit allow-always decision can create a lease consumed in enforce mode.

mode.description: off disables adaptive evaluation; shadow records eligible candidates without changing decisions; suggest reports candidates but still prompts; enforce may auto-pass only by consuming a bounded lease created by an explicit allow-always decision.

ttlMs.description: Fixed adaptive lease lifetime in milliseconds (1 minute to 1 hour).

maxUses.description: Maximum auto-pass authorizations consumable from one adaptive lease. The budget is deducted before execution and is never refunded based on tool outcome.

suggestAfterApprovals.description: Matching allow-once approvals needed before suggest surfaces a lease hint. Shadow reports eligibility without persisting evidence. These approvals never create a lease or expand authorization.

autoPassSessionKeys.description: Exact colon-delimited session-key segments that auto-pass non-critical approval prompts. Critical calls follow unattendedPolicy.

denyCooldownMs.description: After an explicit deny, matching calls auto-block for this many milliseconds instead of asking again (0 disables). ask→block only; never touches auto or block decisions.

selfProtection.description: Structural self-protection: file-write / shell-command calls whose parameters reference the authority surface (openclaw.json, any path under a .openclaw directory) escalate to a block. Escalation-only and runs before grants/windows are consulted.

enabled.description: Master switch. On by default; escalation can only tighten a decision, never loosen one.

decisionLog.description: Best-effort decision audit trail: memory ring buffer plus optional append-only JSONL. Recording failures never change an enforcement outcome.

maxEntries.description: In-memory ring buffer size. Oldest entries are evicted first.

filePath.description: Optional append-only JSONL path (absolute or ~/...). Omitted = memory only.

floodDetector.description: Non-authorizing approval-flood detector: surfaces a hint when ask prompts arrive at a high rate (the rubber-stamping failure mode). Never auto-passes anything.

windowMs.description: Trailing window over which ask decisions are counted.

threshold.description: Ask count at/above which a hint is surfaced in the approval description.

rules.description: Ordered policy rules. First match wins.

toolName.description: Exact tool name. Omit to match any tool.

toolNamePattern.description: Regex matched against toolName. Omit for no pattern.

toolKind.description: Match host toolKind discriminator (e.g. code_mode_exec, exec, apply_patch).

paramMatcher.description: One-level parameter expression. Use all or any with direct-own equals, in, or missing conditions. Invalid or missing required values never match.
